description: Meet Houston Houston was born and raised in Athens, where he still lives. He’s served in the State House since 2019 representing Barrow, Clarke, Jackson, and Oconee counties. Professionally, Houston has spent his career helping grow small businesses. Today, he works with Carter Engineering, where he's focused on expanding this successful small business in Oconee County.
